SBA, exam structure per subject/grade). This file is the pipeline-facing
flattened view Level 0 reads; regenerate additions from CAPS/ with
open cards and dashboard counts key off them).
Original hand-written rows (no `source` field) predate CAPS/ and keep their
example_problem/tutor assignments; rows with a `source` field were generated
from the CAPS file named there and carry no example_problem/tutor - Level 1
recommends a tutor and derives the worked example for those.
Field names follow the Prompt Template in agent/replay/docs/supacharge-tech.md
S4: Subject, Grade, Topic, Subtopic, Example problem, Tutor, Prior knowledge.
term is the CAPS school term (1-4) per the DBE 2023/24 Annual Teaching Plans;
'all' marks skills topics the ATP integrates across every term; 'unknown'
marks topics with no verifiable ATP placement - do not guess terms.
Run lessons/scripts/atp_drift_check.py against _sources before trusting term
data in a new school year - the DBE reissues ATPs annually.
